description: This Java interface defines a repository for accessing resource entities in a SQL database, including custom queries for resource retrieval, size calculations, and data access, within the Thingsboard project.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndResourceTypeAndResourceKey
methods.description: Finds a resource entity by tenant ID, resource type, and resource key.

methods.name: findAllByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves all resource entities for a given tenant ID with pagination.

methods.name: findResourcesPage
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of resources filtered by resource type, subtype, search text, and tenant/admin context.

methods.name: findResources
methods.description: Finds resources based on filters like resource type, subtype, search text, and tenant/admin context.

methods.name: findResourcesByIds
methods.description: Retrieves resources by their IDs, considering tenant/admin context.

methods.name: sumDataSizeByTenantId
methods.description: Calculates total data size for resources belonging to a tenant.

methods.name: getDataById
methods.description: Fetches resource data bytes by resource ID.

methods.name: getPreviewById
methods.description: Retrieves preview or data bytes for a resource by ID.

methods.name: getDataSizeById
methods.description: Gets the size of resource data by ID.

methods.name: getExternalIdByInternal
methods.description: Retrieves external ID associated with an internal resource ID.

methods.name: findIdsByTenantId
methods.description: Finds resource IDs associated with a tenant, with pagination.

methods.name: getDataInfoById
methods.description: Returns resource data info object containing data and descriptor by ID.
